veranderings.rede: 'Geïdentifiseer' is a formal loanword; 'herken' is the plain Afrikaans word a Grade 6 learner knows.
'Binne die familie' says more clearly that the skill is learnt from family members; 'in die familie' reads like 'it runs in the family'.

veranderings.voor: Die gebruike van die tradisie word ook stap vir stap geleer.
veranderings.na: Daarby word die gebruike van die tradisie stap vir stap geleer.
veranderings.rede: Avoids a second 'ook' straight after the previous sentence's 'ook' while keeping the additive meaning.

veranderings.blok: Erkenning aan die einde van die opleiding
veranderings.voor: Aan die einde word die leerling
veranderings.na: Aan die einde van die leertyd word die leerling
veranderings.rede: 'Aan die einde' has no stated reference in the sentence itself; naming the leertyd makes it clear without adding content.

beskerm_bedenkings.rede: In the glossary sentence 'word tekens ... gelees as so 'n roeping om 'n geneser te word' the participle stands before the as-phrase; natural Afrikaans word order puts it at the end ('word tekens soos ... as so 'n roeping gelees om 'n geneser te word'). The protected wording itself forces the less natural order; a person may want to protect 'as so 'n roeping gelees' instead.
